data.name: Acolyte

feature.name: Shelter of the Faithful
desc: Those who share your faith respect you; established institutions of your faith can provide modest support, ceremonies, care, and reasonable nonhazardous assistance.

personality_traits: I idolize a hero of my faith and often cite that example.
I look for omens and signs in ordinary events.
ideals: Tradition: ancient rites should be preserved.
Charity: I help those in need even at personal cost.
bonds: I would risk my life to recover a lost relic of my faith.
I owe my life to the priest who took me in.
flaws: I judge others harshly and myself even more severely.
I place too much trust in my religious hierarchy.

starting_equipment_notes: Prayer book or prayer wheel; 5 sticks of incense.

data.name: Charlatan

feature.name: False Identity
desc: You maintain a second identity with supporting documents and contacts and can forge documents when you have seen a suitable example.

personality_traits: I fall in and out of love easily.
Flattery is my preferred trick for getting what I want.
ideals: Independence: I am a free spirit.
Aspiration: I am determined to make something of myself.
bonds: I fleeced the wrong person and must keep them from crossing my path.
I owe everything to my mentor.
flaws: I cannot resist a pretty face.
I am always in debt and spend my gains too quickly.

starting_equipment_options.desc: Choose a con prop represented by a gaming set

starting_equipment_notes: The con prop can instead be colored bottles or a fake noble's signet; these narrative alternatives are retained as provenance.

data.name: Criminal

feature.name: Criminal Contact
desc: You have a reliable and trustworthy contact who acts as your liaison to a network of criminals and can pass messages through local messengers and channels.

personality_traits: I always have a plan for when things go wrong.
I am always calm, no matter the situation.
ideals: Honor: I do not steal from others in the trade.
Freedom: chains are meant to be broken.
bonds: I am trying to pay off an old debt to a generous benefactor.
Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made.
flaws: When I see something valuable, I think about how to steal it.
If there is a plan, I will forget it; if I do not forget it, I will ignore it.

starting_equipment_notes: Common clothes are dark and include a hood.

data.name: Spy

feature.name: Criminal Contact
desc: Your clandestine contacts let you exchange messages and information through a trusted network.

personality_traits: I carry habits and stories from my background into every new place.
I have a distinctive way of dealing with people shaped by my former life.
ideals: I try to live by the values that gave my old life meaning.
I want my choices now to define who I become.
bonds: Someone or something from my past still matters deeply to me.
I owe a debt, promise, or loyalty that I refuse to forget.
flaws: An old habit from my former life still gets me into trouble.
I have a blind spot that people who know my background can exploit.

starting_equipment_notes: Spy uses the Criminal mechanical package with espionage flavor.
